title: hs-drive: an MCP server that runs the modded game end to end, now to a loaded character
body:
## Summary

`hs-drive` is a local MCP server that lets an agent run the modded game end to end: launch it through ForgePact's own launcher engine, drive the plugin over `bp_ipc`, take screenshots, inject input, back up and restore saves, and now **select a character**. It's dev tooling only: nothing shipped to players imports it, and `tests.test_hs_drive_mcp_release_boundary` pins that.

This branch is the whole feature: the core server (`claude/workorder-impl-hs-drive-mcp-core`, fast-forwarded here), `hs_input`, and `hs_select_character`.

- **Server:** fourteen tools. Each one checks its instrument against something known to work before trusting an empty result (`hs_selfcheck`). Every refusal carries a `reason`. Save backup and restore fail closed and refuse while the game is running.
- **`hs_input`:** keys and clicks into the game's own window only, by `SendInput` or `PostMessage`. `click` takes `hold_ms` (default 120) because a click with no hold activates nothing (C-1.10).
- **`hs_select_character(slot=1)`:** main menu → Play local → slot 1 → Play, as held clicks at the measured client fractions. The proof is `orbpickup stat`'s `player via` field, read while the tool itself has `orbpickup` armed: `none` on the way is the negative control, and a resolver route after `Play` is the proof. Anything unmeasured (other slots, a non-16:9 window) refuses `layout_not_measured` before any input is sent.
- **Live-gate fix (`3b701d2`):** the plugin frames every reply between `---- running command file ----` and `---- done ----`, and the arming check and the stat parser both treated the whole reply as one line. The test double now frames its replies too, and against the old code 12 of 25 tests fail.
- **`AGENTS.md`:** one branch and one PR per module, per feature.

Companion ForgePact PR (research + contract tests, nothing player-visible): https://github.com/falorfrozen-cmd/ForgePact/pull/60. This PR does **not** bump the `ForgePact` gitlink; that follows once #60 merges.

## Test plan

- [x] `py -3 -m unittest discover -s tests` → `Ran 925 tests`, `OK (skipped=10)`, all environmental
- [x] **L-1 live gate, 2026-09-21, through the MCP server (owner sign-off):** player build `24020eac`; `hs_selfcheck` six `pass`; `hs_launch` `plugin_ready` in 15.8 s; `hs_select_character(1)` → `character_loaded` in 17.5 s, with `none` on the menu, `Play local` and slot screens and `GetMyPlayer` after `Play`; `hs_stop_game` graceful; after restore the saves were hash-identical to a separate manual copy. The full record is in the Verification table of `docs/tools/hs-drive-mcp.md`.

## Update: menulayout-driven listing, resize settle, and force focus

Since the summary above, `hs_select_character` moved from clicking fixed
client-window fractions to reading live button positions from ForgePact's new
`menulayout` command (see companion PR
https://github.com/falorfrozen-cmd/ForgePact/pull/61 — read-only, player note
in `ForgePact/release-notes-v1.4.5.md`, no version cut), added a settle-poll
for the window resize the plugin performs after `plugin_ready`, and — after
live-gate attempts 2–4 were refused `foreground_not_game` because Windows'
foreground lock does not honor `SetForegroundWindow` from a process spawned
under another foreground app — now escalates through `AttachThreadInput` and
a zero-effect `input_unlock` step before giving up. This escalation is opt-in
and used only by `hs_select_character`; `hs_input`'s schema and one-attempt
foreground rule are unchanged. Every result now reports `focus_via`/
`focus_trail`.

Live-gate attempt 5, 2026-09-21, passed both required rows: `hs_select_character(1)`
and `hs_select_character(2)` each reached `phase: character_loaded` with a
correct `layout_trail`, a `focus_trail`, and clean save restores. Full history
(attempts 1–5) is in `docs/tools/hs-drive-mcp.md`'s Verification table, rows
M1–M6, M-L2 and M-L2b.

`py -3 -m unittest discover -s tests` → `Ran 990 tests in 186.816s`, `OK
(skipped=10)`.
